verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs say dev/staging/production environments can enable or disable flags independently, per environment. A toggle endpoint can switch flags in one or more environments from deploy scripts. A readonly SDK Connection Endpoint serves a subset of flag data to SDKs, but the evidence never says SDK keys are scoped to a single environment, and custom environments are listed only under a higher pricing tier. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that SDK keys/connections are scoped per environment, clarity on which environments are available on lower tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
